previous_goal_turn_classification: no scientific progress; administrative recording only because further research was stopped by owner
current_goal_turn_classification: no scientific progress; same authorization block verified
blocking_condition: Further pursuit of the unachieved original research goal is not authorized after the owner-requested benchmark and closeout. A new explicit owner instruction is required.
count_basis: Original goal turn: owner requested benchmark completion then stop; benchmark and closeout completed
First automatic continuation: stop revalidated, no research resumed
Second automatic continuation: same stop revalidated, no authorized research action remains
resume_rule: Any future explicit owner resumption starts a fresh blocked audit; these three turns must not be reused.
